Credible candidates IF verified live on GitHub first: go-gitea/gitea#4898 ($300), Dokploy/dokploy#1413 ($100), Dokploy/dokploy#416 ($50), comet-ml/opik#1010 ($50). RECOMMENDATION: do NOT build auto-claim pipeline — economics don't justify it; pursue only single verified bounties with Aaron's approval.
